==================
Binary arithmetic
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Dim a = 1 + 2
        Dim b = 10 - 3
        Dim c = 4 * 5
        Dim d = 20 / 4
        Dim e = 20 \ 3
        Dim f = 10 Mod 3
        Dim g = 2 ^ 8
    End Sub
End Module

Module M

==================
Nested query expressions
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Dim q = From x In items
                Where x > 0
                Let doubled = x * 2
                Order By doubled Descending
                Select doubled
    End Sub
End Module
